record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) A bill or cheque becomes a _________ only when it is receipted and stamped "paid". (b) At the end of each month, __________ should verify the cash balance in the cash book and record a signed and dated certificate to that effect. (c) The duplicate keys of departmental treasure chests should be rendered in the custody of _________________. (d) Money may not be withdrawn from the Government account except by ______________. (e) As a general rule, cheques shall not be issued for sums less than ________ unless it is permissible under the provisions of law.
